department: Research School of Astronomy and Astrophysics

deadline.value: RSAA's own international PhD scholarship round (its preferred route for international students) closes 15 November 2026; three reference letters are due one week later. Interviews are expected in February 2027. The ANU-wide round is separate.
deadline.quote: by the application deadline of 15 November 2026

also.quote: Note that there is a separate ANU-wide deadline for applications into the various ANU PhD programs, which is at the end of August each year. However, the information provided here and how to apply into the RSAA PhD program is the preferred pathway for international students to apply for a PhD at RSA

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to contact RSAA faculty about projects before the deadline; a committee reviews applications and students choose a topic and supervisor after starting.
supervisor.quote: Applicants are encouraged to contact RSAA faculty about potential research projects in the applicant's areas of interest prior to the application deadline.

also.quote: You will commence work on finding a PhD research topic right from the start, by undertaking literature reviews, exploring work groups and meeting with potential supervisors.

funding.value: RSAA offers a number of fully funded international PhD scholarships through a competitive round; winners get a tax-free scholarship, an RSAA top-up and a tuition-fee waiver.
funding.quote: for a number of fully-funded PhD scholarships | Successful PhD scholarship applicants are fully supported with a tax-free scholarship plus an RSAA top-up scholarship, and tuition-fee waiver.

also.quote: Annual indicative fee for international students | $57,640.00

entry_route.value: Open to undergraduate and master's students, but the degree must include a significant research component (pure coursework does not qualify); the program page asks for First Class Honours (H1) or equivalent.
entry_route.quote: invites applications from outstanding undergraduate and Master's students of all nationalities | Ultimately, admission into the ANU PhD program requires you to have had a significant research component in your undergraduate/Master studies (pure coursework would not fulfil the basic admission requirements)

also.quote: Present a relevant Bachelor Honours degree or international equivalent | With a minimum grade of First Class Honours (H1) or equivalent.

notes: Four-year full-time PhD (academic plan 9670XPHD). Apply by emailing one combined PDF to rsaa.international@anu.edu.au. English requirements can be met after the deadline.
